source_title: Kinetics of Ozonation of Typical Sulfonamides in Water
procedure_summary: In a covered glass semi-continuous reactor (50 mm internal diameter, 700 mm length), 500 mL Milli-Q water was pre-ozonated for 5.5 min. Sulfadiazine was then added; pH was fixed at 2.5 with orthophosphate buffer and 25 mg/L tert-butanol suppressed hydroxyl-radical reactions. Ozone was continuously purged to maintain its concentration. Timed samples were quenched with sodium thiosulfate and quantified by C18 HPLC-UV. The pseudo-first-order slope divided by dissolved ozone yielded kO3 = 261 M^-1 s^-1.
